name: Alias
tagline: Upload an executable and get readable code, its behaviours and a safety verdict before you run it.
problem: Antivirus warnings say a file may be unsafe but not what it does, so users cannot judge them.
solution: Decompiles the binary, converts pseudo-C to readable C with a specialised model, cleans it with an LLM, extracts strings and behaviours such as network or file access, and explains them with a safe, suspicious or unsafe verdict in a browser extension.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop in an .exe and read what it would do.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “1Password: Best Security Hack” among 160 submissions.
Explains behaviour instead of only labelling files.
Decompilation plus explanation is real security depth for a student build.

lessons: In security, an explanation users can check beats a bare verdict.
